images.note: Real screenshot from dbt's own official documentation (docs/collaborate/explore-projects) showing the dbt Catalog 'Test Status' lens over a real project's lineage graph: each model node carries a colored badge for its latest test status (Pass, Error, Fail, Warn, Skipped, Reused). This is the real, current dbt Cloud surface for seeing test outcomes at a glance across a whole project, and it is what a real failing generic test looks like in production dbt tooling.

imageNote: Found via curl on docs.getdbt.com/docs/collaborate/explore-projects — confirmed not JS-rendered, real tag with a relative /img/docs/... path, same pattern as the pilot lesson.
